known_fixes: Django health checks require migrated tables, so the container runs python src/manage.py migrate --noinput before starting the server; initial migrations take more than 60 seconds on a fresh PostgreSQL sidecar.
Development settings required an explicit empty AWS_PROFILE to avoid reading a missing config.keys attribute.
discovery_notes: ResearchHub backend is a Django 5.2 service using uv and uv.lock. It runs on port 8000, exposes /health/, and requires PostgreSQL plus Redis for its standard development configuration. The existing root .dockerignore excluded the entire build context, so it was narrowed to dependency, cache, secret, and development-container exclusions for the root CodePress build.
